task: T6 of the owner-approved autonomous plan: crop yields
status: declared before any model-vs-GAEZ comparison (GAEZ rasters downloaded and only their shape/range read)
question: Does the Harvest rain-fed cereal response (scripts/land_people.py crop_yield: best season, FAO-33 Ky water line, failure smoothstep(fw, 0.3, 0.5), supply 0.8 P + soil; x margin reliability cold (-2, 10) C, dry (0, 0.35) P/PET) give the observed SPATIAL PATTERN of low-input rain-fed attainable yield? The yield LEVEL (1 t/ha ceiling) is a period assumption and is reported, not fitted.
target: FAO/IIASA GAEZ v4, res05, CRUTS32 1971-2000, LOW input, RAIN-FED, without CO2 fertilisation, attainable yield of the best occurring suitability class (yxLr0_whe, yxLr0_brl; kg DW/ha, 5 arc-min; data/cache/gaez, not redistributed)
model_input: WorldClim 2.1 1970-2000 tavg, tmax, tmin, prec averaged to 0.5 deg over land (>= 50 % land); Hargreaves PET with the model's top-of-atmosphere radiation (Earth tilt 23.44, 365 days); irrigation 0; wheat and barley separately
domain: 0.5-deg cells in the Earth window (0-56 N, 12 W-125 E) valid in both grids (GAEZ zeros = unsuitable are kept)
split: 10-degree checkerboard offset by 5 deg: dev 0, blind 1

scores.primary: mean over wheat and barley of the Spearman correlation between model grain yield and GAEZ yield over cells
scores.f1: mean over the two crops of the F1 of 'grows' (model >= 0.05 t/ha vs GAEZ >= 100 kg/ha)
scores.level: median model/GAEZ on cells where both grow (reported only)

choice: variant with the highest dev primary

blind_gates.G1: chosen blind primary >= current blind primary + 0.03
blind_gates.G2: chosen blind f1 >= current blind f1 - 0.02
blind_gates.G3: if the window shift changes, the observed crop-calendar diagnostic (reports/OBSERVED_CROP_CALENDARS_20261103.md) must not get worse in 'duration outside the model envelope' for winter wheat or barley
blind_gates.adopt: G1, G2 and G3: the Harvest crop response takes the chosen setting at the bundled rebuild (the harvest cascade). Otherwise current stays; the pattern agreement is reported.
